content: Matter.js 0.19.0 is the latest stable as of 2025-2026. Matter.js integrates with React via the matter-js npm package and using useEffect for engine creation. The library provides a physics engine for 2D particle interactions. For educational simulations, Matter.js is simpler than PhysX but less performant at scale. Key modules: Engine, World, Bodies, Body, Events. Can be paired with react-matterjs wrapper or used imperatively with refs.
